_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With the score sitting in the Anxiety band and only 3% of 12h windows producing ±2+ point moves over the last week, the coil regime makes HOLD the statistically honest call — neither brain has produced a confirmed breaker signal strong enough to override the base rate.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls UP drift to Complacency while narrative implies a bottoming process; the judge splits the difference and holds at Anxiety pending a confirmed breaker.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows turn positive + funding holds above 0.01% with BTC sustaining $62K (analyst's confirm), OR Fear & Greed drops below 20 with a volume capitulation spike (narrative's bottom confirm)
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 25 with BTC breaking $58K and funding flipping negative — this would validate the narrative's deeper-capitulation case and force a phase downgrade to Panic
